notes.title: Judgeball's Early Access set to be released this November 28!
notes.content:
Everyone here at Wild Bishop is really pleased to announce that Judgeball's Early Access will be released this [b]Tuesday 28 November 2023[/b]! This is a big deal for the team behind this game and we're really looking forward to seeing all enthusiasts joining this adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508363/2a92d49bcaf6e6c318c7196411d94555f1fc148f.jpg[/img]

[h2]What can you expect of this Early Access?[/h2]

To celebrate this important milestone, the [b]entire Judgeball game will be available for free for one week[/b] from the moment the Early Access of the game releases. To get this access, you'll have to download the demo version of the game on Steam on the day of the release. 

As of December 5: players will have to pay the game (15.99€) to be able to enjoy the full Judgeball experience. [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wildbishop/judgeball-lethal-arena-a-handbrawl-game?ref=dcmcij]Our Kickstarter campaign[/url] offers the possibility of buying the game at a discount. 
Players will still be able to get a glimpse of the game by playing in the solo mode, which will always be available in the demo version of the game for free.

[h2]Seal joins the arena[/h2]

A new champion will join the arena when the game releases! Seal, the drunk angel, is ready to dominate in Judgeball! Masterize its unique skills and seize the victory for your team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508363/1603f07ee69b25fcec5726b22538192ee8a0e963.jpg[/img]

[h2]Looking forward for this new step with our community[/h2]

This is a really important step for everyone here at Wild Bishop and we're looking forward to sharing it with you. There will be much more exciting news coming in the upcoming days and we're looking forward to sharing those with you, so stay tuned!

notes.title: No more draws! An original way of defining a winner.
notes.content:
We've been working on the draw resolution for a while now. Here at Wild Bishop we enjoy creativity. That's why we didn't wanted a "golden point" system to define who has won the match. When we rose the idea, it sounded like an evidence: a death match. If a game ends on a draw, players will have to go through a death match, last team with a player standing wins the game. We see this new system as an opportunity for new strategies to emerge. We hope that the overtime death match will lead to epic memories being made during your journey in the arena!

Judgeball is a one-of-a-kind game. We wanted our artistic direction to better show this uniqueness. We chose to operate a change in our style. Champions are now in a cel-shading style, allowing for a more assumed personnality as well as a clearer visibility during your games.

We invite you to find all the information about the 0.5.1 patch in the patch note beneath.

See you soon in the arena!

Judgeball: Lethal Arena - Update 0.5.1 - Patch Note - Thursday June 22 2023

### Improvement

- New graphics for champions
- Draw resolution
- Mind is now available
- Private game - Add a "bench" position allowing players to change team when all slots are filled
- Low life AI should wait at the defender position if a player is already GK before entering the ally zone
- Player should always respawn directly after death in practice mode
- Added a "motion blur" on/off settings in the graphical setting
- It is now possible to unlock heroes by completing special missions
- Special missions will now be displayed before daily and weekly missions
- Champions now need to be bought in order for a player to own it

### Bug Fix

- Fixed a bug which was seeing the ball disappear inside the wall
- Diving arrow too big and not correctly displayed on a "high" resolution
- A bug could result in the goalkeeper not able to catch the ball correctly
- Sometimes players could end up blocked in "spectator" camera during and after a fatality
- Gail wasn't smiling during the celebration animation if the graphic quality was set to low or medium
- Gail wasn't grabbing the ball during her tackle if she was too close
- Fixed Stu's Seagull shot aim, sometimes the ability would miss even if aimed properly
- Text chat messages weren't in red/blue color inside the end game screen
- Social Networks Buttons couldn't be selected and pressed when using a gamepad
- The ball could fall under the floor when receiving a pass during a tackle 
- Some items wouldn't show as "owned" inside the shop panel after buying it
- A character could get propelled on the arena wall after being hit by a Seagull shot
- An annoying sound could be played when an AI was in the goalkeeper zone
- Stu's seagull shot sound could sometime be heard in loop in the middle of the arena
- Characters could flicker or rotate during a goal celebration animation
- Sometimes pressing "H" to hide the ingame's help could not be working
- The Diving arrow could stay displayed after a respawn if the player was still holding it when an animation started playing
- The ball was bouncing back after a pass to an ally if the teammate is down
- Sometimes a fatalizable character wouldn't be executed if punched by an opponent
- Missions could be incorrect in client lobby after a "play again"
- Sometimes a shockwave would interrupt a tackle
- The ball would sometimes go in the air and then respawn in the middle of the arena

notes.title: Announcing AI!
notes.content:
We are super excited to announce that Codename: Judgement now has AI players! Want to get on the pitch but don't have enough team members on the benches? We've got you covered!

How it works: Usually, a match will have 6 players, but if this isn't possible the game will fill empty slots with AI players after a minute wait. So... if your game takes a little while to find a match, don't panic!

As always, we'd love to hear your thoughts - Let us know on Discord!

- Wild Bishop

notes.title: Join our playtest, get exclusive rewards!
notes.content:
Want to get brutal on the playing field? Join us for our playtest, Kicking off on Friday 5th onwards! We have a whole bunch of new features we're excited to share with you.. and the best part? Play between 18:00 BST and 20:00 BST to claim exclusive rewards - bonus Nyxian dollars to spend on character customisation and upgrades, and a one-time limited edition skin! 

Thanks to everyone who signed up for the first playtest - we learned so much from you all and we hope you come back and see what we have done to help us knock it out of the park!

We have had reports of some players finding issues such as:
- during tutorial, ball gets stuck & cant be retrieved
- NPCs sometimes disappearing during the tutorial
- occasional issues with logging in
- getting stuck in queue during matchmaking when there are fewer than 4 players
... If any of this affects you, please try the age-old wisdom of turning it off and on again ;)

And of course, if you have any feedback please let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/N8qbau5Q5t]Discord![/url]

See you in the arena!

- Wild Bishop
